purpose: GRADE ONLY: no product changes, no speculative execution outcomes
distinction: Observed pass percentage is calculated only from actual attempts. NOT_RUN has null performance. Coverage percentage is executed/planned, not runtime reliability. Overall is the fraction of capability gates with >=90% proven observed outcomes and must not be called product success probability.
